gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-kr: Blockletter draws with the plain, pressure-free line of a ballpoint, its tall midsection standing out. And Noto Sans KR, with generous gaps in its curves and a big x-height against stubby ascenders, is the plain sans that makes the pair so usable.
